about: FREQ cover template: the approved FREQ 001 covers at delivery size. Only the regions below are regenerated for a new track; every other pixel is copied from the template.

style.header: letter-spaced classic Roman serif capitals in warm ivory-gold, small, evenly tracked, separated by centered middle dots, exactly like the existing header
style.title_line1: large bold classical Roman serif capitals in brushed ivory-silver metal with a subtle bevel and soft glow, exactly like the existing first title line
style.title_line2: larger bold classical Roman serif capitals in polished 3D gold metal with bevel, specular highlights and warm glow, exactly like the existing second title line
